text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho enjoyed spending the<n>weekends at
her grandma's home, a<n>remote place surrounded
by all kinds<n>of wild flora.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There, she studied magic under her<n>grandmother,
who lived a free<n>lifestyle befitting that of a great
witch.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Well then, are you ready, Sweepy?<n>Give it a try
yourself—just like I taught<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Grandma! Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Gera, gera—uninium! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Nicely done. Now, you smell that? That<n>sweet,
flowery smell—it never fails to<n>bring a smile to this
old lady's face.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff... Hey, you're right! Wowie,wow, I really did it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that was a perfect display of<n>herbal geranium
magic. What's more,<n>this strong scent also drives
away<n>nasty pests.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
And that's not all—now we can make<n>delicious
herbal tea and jam, too!<n>Come here Sweepy, help
me carry<n>these.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Okay! Hehe, "gera, gera, uninium! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Wowie! Magic is so super fun! I<n>wanna do more...
There's gotta be<n>sooo many more spells I can
learn!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Grandma! You see, I wanna<n>learn a lot, lot
more magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So I was wondering, what's the<n>bestest, most
amazingest spell<n>you've ever cast?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: My best spell, you say? Let me<n>think...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: ...It would have to be racing magic, no<n>doubt about it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
The racing scene is special, you see.<n>You'll find all
kinds of spells—some<n>that'll make you jump for
joy, others<n>that'll make your heart flutter... or<n>even
feel sad.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
But you know, there's a<n>one-of-a-kind magic that
can only be<n>used there. Back when I used to race<n>in
my younger days, I found and<n>learned that magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
My little Sweepy. I hope that one day,<n>you too will
learn to wield that very<n>same magic...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
And when you do, I believe you'll<n>finally find the
"fun" you've been<n>looking for—and it'll be better
than<n>you could ever imagine.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Then what are we waiting for?! I<n>wanna race too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And then, just like Grandma, I'll<n>show everyone
the most amazingest<n>magic in the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! How about that—I'm<n>looking forward to
seeing just what<n>kind of magic you'll use.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Magic is fun. With it, everything thatbores me gets blown away.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to learn more magic like that,<n>so I came to
Tracen Academy to look<n>for this racing magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how much I run, I can't<n>find it
anywhere! And the teachers<n>and instructors are
always getting on<n>my case and telling me what to
do!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So I've had it! This isn't fun at all!<n>It's boring!
Everything is sooo boring<n>now!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. Maybe I should just... quitracing.
choice_data_list: But that would be such a waste!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I blurt that out before I can stop<n>myself. After all, the
image of her<n>comeback in that scrimmage is still
freshly seared into my mind.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And besides, after hearing that story<n>of hers, I feel
like I understand what<n>her grandmother was
thinking back<n>then.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She exceeded in so many different<n>areas, but none
of them were fun for<n>her. Because all those
activities<n>weren't what she really wanted to<n>do.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
What's important is whether or not<n>she wants to
do something. That's<n>why her grandmother
showed her<n>magic. She gave Sweep the<n>motivation
she needed.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho made the decision by<n>herself to enter
the racing scene. She<n>did it because she wanted to.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The only person who can brighten up<n>her life, who
can make it exciting—is<n>herself. But if she's having
trouble<n>taking the next step alone, then...
choice_data_list: Are you really going to give up on racing magic?
Are you really going to give up on racing magic?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Of course not, dummy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's the best magic there is!<n>And I, Sweepy,
will one day become a<n>great witch fit to wield that
power!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...And y'know, I promised her. I<n>promised Grandma
that I would learn<n>racing magic!
choice_data_list: If anyone can do it, it's you.
If anyone can do it, it's you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I reassure her with complete and utter<n>confidence.
Because there's no<n>doubt in my mind that—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I say this sincerely because I saw it<n>with my own
two eyes. Because I<n>want the magical girl in front of
me to<n>never stop believing in magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Because I hope that this seed of<n>potential can
sprout amid adversity<n>into a beautiful blossom.
choice_data_list:
Do you want to see what the world of racing truly
has to offer?

Do you want to see what the world of racing truly
has to offer?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The world of racing? Can I find the<n>magic I'm
looking for there?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Then from today on, you're my<n>familiar.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You don't even know what a familiar<n>is? What a
dummy. A familiar is<n>always by their magical girl's
side<n>and helps them with aaall kinds of<n>things!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Until I learn racing magic, you're<n>sticking it out with
me! Got it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, familiar! I know you heard me,<n>so give me an
answer!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: How did things end up like this?!
